    if not results:
        results = await create_curated_collection_by_search(
            page, keyword="AI", max_results=20, resolve_links=True
        )

    # If still no results, cannot open the article; print False and return.
    if not results:
        print(False)
        return

    # Choose best match heuristically (prefer exact match, then fuzzy, else first result).
    chosen = None
    target_title_lower = "disrupting yourself in the age of ai"
    for r in results:

    except Exception:

    img_locator = page.get_by_role("img")

    keywords = ["ai", "artificial intelligence", "machine learning", "deep learning"]

    found_related = False

    for i in range(img_count):
        img = img_locator.nth(i)
        try:

        except Exception:
            alt = ""
        try:
            src = (await img.get_attribute("src")) or ""
        except Exception:
            src = ""

        combined = (alt + " " + src).lower()
        if any(k in combined for k in keywords):
            found_related = True
            break

        # Check nearby figure or parent element text for keywords.

            )
            if caption_text and any(k in caption_text.lower() for k in keywords):
                found_related = True
                break
        except Exception:
            pass

    # Print boolean result: True if an AI-related image was found, False otherwise.
